effect_sizes.name: sampled <e^{-Y}> at alpha=0.5 (the POWERED check: Y is O(1e-2))
effect_sizes.method: CLT band over 3000 exact-kernel quench paths

n_justification: 3000 trajectories: enough for the CLT band on e^{-Y} (heavy right tail noted) while keeping the run minutes-scale. Two alpha points: 0.5 carries the statistical power (Y ~ 1e-2); 0.95 is retained but LOW-POWER (Y ~ 6e-5, red-team O-4) — its bracket verdict is not evidence of kernel correctness.
notes: The estimator-side IFT check — the only non-tautological IFT verification (the exact transfer telescopes): finite-sample <e^{-Y}> brackets 1 at both alpha points, and the sampled mean Y agrees with the exact lagging-p computation.
